headline: Making progress, stuck, or waiting on you?
text: Your coding agent is busy. But is it making progress, stuck, or waiting on you?

headline: One dashboard. Across your projects.
text: One local dashboard brings your tracked threads together. Pick a thread to see the current step, progress, and blockers.

headline: Know what needs your answer.
text: Questions show what needs your answer, and what can continue while you wait. Reply in your agent chat.

headline: Details, when you need them.
text: Open the plan, files, or developer details without leaving the page.

headline: Updates come from your coding agent.
text: Your agent publishes updates as it works. No server. No extra account.

headline: Task Lantern
text: Task Lantern. Open source, for your next long task.
